# Proteotranscriptomic Integration

This analysis integrates IsoFrac-derived proteoform data with long-read PacBio transcript sequencing to improve protein isoform identification and interpretation. While IsoFrac detects proteoform-specific peptide traces across fractionation gradients, PacBio provides complementary full-length transcript evidence, enabling cross-validation between protein- and RNA-level isoforms.

The workflow extends the IsoFrac similarity and enrichment framework by incorporating PacBio-derived protein sequences into the database comparison step. This allows each IsoFrac peak to be evaluated against both UniProt and PacBio candidates using a unified scoring model. By comparing enrichment, mass agreement, and machine learning–based scores, the pipeline identifies the most likely isoform assignments and highlights cases where PacBio uniquely explains observed proteoforms.

In addition to improving assignment accuracy, this integration enables systematic comparisons between databases, quantification of agreement/discrepancies, and identification of potential novel isoforms supported by proteomics data. The results are summarized through enrichment analyses, ROC evaluation, delta-mass comparisons, and visualization of protein–RNA concordance.

Overall, this RMarkdown documents a combined proteogenomic approach to refine isoform annotation by leveraging orthogonal evidence from mass spectrometry and long-read sequencing.


## Initializaion


This section prepares the PacBio protein reference dataset and integrates it with the IsoFrac workflow.

It loads and cleans PacBio-derived ORF sequences, ensures consistent gene (ENSG) annotation, and aligns them with the existing UniProt-based protein database. Missing mappings are corrected where possible, and redundant entries are removed to obtain a unique sequence-level representation.

Finally, the PacBio dataset is formatted to match the IsoFrac data structure and combined with previously generated IsoFrac results (Results_CombinedGels). Additional identifiers (e.g., PacBio-specific transcript codes) are created to enable downstream integration, comparison, and enrichment analysis between RNA-derived isoforms and proteomics evidence.

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

# Work from the Rmd location
setwd(dirname(rstudioapi::documentPath()))

# Container for all downstream results in this section
Results_CombinedGels_PacBio <- list()


  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Load the cleaned PacBio object from disk
  # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # hu1 <- load("../IsoFrac_20230217_SimilaritiesTesting_2/ORFpacBioProteinID_20230328_mod2.rda")
  # hu2 <- load("../IsoFrac_20230217_SimilaritiesTesting_2/ORFpacBioProteinID_20230328_mod3.rda")

  # Collapse to unique sequences and drop columns not needed downstream
  ORFpacBioProteinIDNew <- ORFpacBioProteinID[, {
    temp <- .SD
    temp$ProteinID <- NULL
    temp$paralogues <- NULL
    temp$overlaped <- NULL
    temp$ORF_len <- NULL
    temp <- unique(temp)

    if (dim(temp)[1] > 1) {
      dim(unique(temp))
      stop()
    }

    temp
    temp
  }, SEQUENCE]

  load("./ORFpacBioProteinID_20230328_mod4.rda")

  # PacBio reference table used in the rest of the analysis
  PacBIO <- ORFpacBioProteinIDNew


# Ensure the PacBio results container exists
if (!exists("Results_CombinedGels_PacBio")) {
  Results_CombinedGels_PacBio <- list()
}

# Load the main IsoFrac combined-gels results
load("Results_CombinedGels.rda")

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Derive a PacBio-specific code from the "Other" field
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
PacBIO[, PacBioCode := {
  pb <- .BY$Other
  paste(unique(grep("^PB\\.", unlist(strsplit(pb, ";|\\|")), value = TRUE)), collapse = ";")
}, Other]

# Create a combined ENST identifier that includes the PacBio code
PacBIO$ENST2 <- paste(PacBIO$ENST, PacBIO$PacBioCode, sep = "_")
PacBIO$ENST2[PacBIO$PacBioCode == ""] <- PacBIO$ENST[PacBIO$PacBioCode == ""]

# Replace the original transcript identifier with the combined one
PacBIO$ENST <- PacBIO$ENST2

```

## Extra Functions

```{r}
## --- Extra Functions ---------------------------------------------------------

library(RSQLite)
library(plotly)

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Map peptide evidence and Pfam domains onto protein sequence positions
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF_DB_Peptidemapping <- function(
  x,
  IsoFrac_Domain_SequenceAnalysis,
  ProteinSequencesCategories,
  symbol = 19,
  invertOrder = FALSE,
  geli = 1,
  allgels = TRUE,
  facetPlot = TRUE,
  gelTraces = TRUE
) {
  cat("\r", x)

  # Pull all peptide/domain annotations for the selected gene
  subsetTable <<- IsoFrac_Domain_SequenceAnalysis[ENS == x]

  # Optionally encode gel identity in the cluster label
  if (allgels) {
    subsetTable$HDBscanCluster <- paste(
      subsetTable$HDBscanCluster,
      gsub("_", ".", subsetTable$gels),
      sep = "#"
    )
  } else {
    subsetTable <- subsetTable[grep(c("5per", "8per", "10per")[geli], gels)]
  }

  # Get all protein sequences for this gene and prepare labels with MW
  SEt <- ProteinSequencesCategories[ENSG == x, {
    paste(paste(unique(ProteinID), collapse = ";"), round(mw(.BY$SEQUENCE)), sep = " MW:")
  }, .(SEQUENCE)]

  SE <- SEt$SEQUENCE
  names(SE) <- gsub("_HUMAN", "", SEt$V1)

  # Align sequences across isoforms
  dfAlign <- msa::msa(SE, type = "protein", verbose = FALSE, method = "ClustalOmega")
  dff <- as.data.frame(dfAlign@unmasked)

  # Convert alignment coordinates to residue positions in each sequence
  MatchFun <- lapply(strsplit(dff$x, ""), function(x) {
    sapply(seq_along(x), function(y) {
      if (x[y] != "-") sum(x[1:y] != "-") else 0
    })
  })

  if (length(names(SE)) > 0) {
    names(MatchFun) <- names(dfAlign@unmasked)
  }

  MatchFun <- lapply(MatchFun, function(x) {
    x[x == 0] <- NA
    x
  })

  # Long table: one row per alignment position / sequence
  hu <- as.data.table(MatchFun)
  hu$Position <- seq_len(nrow(hu))
  hu <- melt(hu, id.vars = "Position")
  hu[, MW := as.numeric(gsub(".*.MW:", "", variable)), value]
  hu$variable <- factor(as.character(hu$variable), unique(hu$variable[order(hu$MW)]))

  # Pfam/domain annotations for this gene
  DomainInfo <- PfamDomainMappingsDomainSequence[ensembl_gene_id == x]
  hu$Domain <- ""

  print("Mapping Domains and Peptide to Protein Sequence")

  # Iterate over each protein sequence in the alignment
  for (i in unique(hu$variable)) {
    SEi <- which(names(SE) == i)
    SEsel <- SE[SEi]

    # Add domain annotations for this sequence
    if (length(SEsel) > 0) {
      DomainInfoi <- DomainInfo[SEQUENCE == SEsel]
      if (nrow(DomainInfoi) > 0) {
        DomainInfoi[, {
          sel <- !is.na(match(hu$value, .BY$pfam_start:.BY$pfam_end)) & hu$variable == i
          hu$Domain[sel] <<- paste(hu$Domain[sel], .BY$Pfam_Description)
          NULL
        }, .(pfam_start, pfam_end, Pfam_Description)]
      }
    }

    # Map peptide sequences onto the aligned sequence
    selectedP <- subsetTable[ENS == x, ]
    SEsel_IL <- gsub("I", "L", SEsel)

    PeptidesMappings <- selectedP[, {
      gr <- aregexec(.BY$sequence, SEsel_IL)
      gr <- gr[gr > 0]
      if (length(gr) > 0) {
        sapply(gr, function(pos) pos:(pos + nchar(.BY$sequence) - 1))
      } else {
        as.integer(NA)
      }
    }, .(sequence, DomainCategory, ClusterType, Category, IsoFrac_MW, HDBscanCluster)]

    # Encode peptide identity with the cluster label
    PeptidesMappings$sequence <- paste(PeptidesMappings$sequence, PeptidesMappings$HDBscanCluster, sep = "_")

    # Collapse multiple mappings into one entry per alignment position
    PeptidesMappingsCollapsed <- PeptidesMappings[, .(
      Category = paste(unique(Category[Category != "tryptic"]), collapse = ";"),
      Mapped = length(Category),
      IsoFrac = paste(sort(unique(IsoFrac_MW)), collapse = ";"),
      Sequences = paste(unique(sequence), collapse = ";")
    ), V1]

    # Transfer peptide annotations back to alignment table
    Posis <- hu$value
    PeptidesMappingsCollapsedMatched <- PeptidesMappingsCollapsed[match(Posis, V1)]

    hu$Category[hu$variable == i] <- PeptidesMappingsCollapsedMatched$Category[hu$variable == i]
    hu$Identified_by_Peptide[hu$variable == i] <- PeptidesMappingsCollapsedMatched$V1[hu$variable == i]
    hu$IsoFracMW[hu$variable == i] <- PeptidesMappingsCollapsedMatched$IsoFrac[hu$variable == i]
    hu$Identified <- !is.na(hu$Identified_by_Peptide)
    hu$Sequences[hu$variable == i] <- PeptidesMappingsCollapsedMatched$Sequences[hu$variable == i]
  }

  # Collapse domain labels per position
  hu[, Domain_all := {
    di <- unique(.SD$Domain)
    paste(unique(di), collapse = ";")
  }, Position]

  # Mark peptide starts/ends for nterm/cterm calls
  selectedP_terminal <- hu[Category == "new_nterm" | Category == "new_cterm",
                           .(value = unique(value)),
                           .(IsoFracMW, variable, Category, Position)]

  hu$Domain_all <- gsub("^; ", "", hu$Domain_all)

  # Plot proteins + Pfam domains
  MSAPlot <- ggplot(
    hu[!is.na(value)][order(MW)],
    aes(Position, variable, color = Domain_all, size = Identified)
  ) +
    geom_point(pch = symbol, alpha = 0.5) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_viridis_d() +
    ylab("DataBase Entries")

  # Prepare peptide-level plotting table
  SpeciPeps <- hu[!is.na(value) & Identified == TRUE, .(
    IsoFracMW_single = { unlist(strsplit(IsoFracMW, ";")) }
  ), .(Position, variable, value, Domain, Category, Identified_by_Peptide, Identified, Domain_all, Sequences)]

  SpeciPeps <- SpeciPeps[, {
    sel <- rep(TRUE, nrow(.SD))
    if (.BY$Category == "new_nterm") {
      sel <- which(Position == min(Position))
    }
    if (.BY$Category == "new_cterm") {
      sel <- which(Position == max(Position))
    }
    .SD[sel]
  }, .(Category, Sequences)]

  SpeciPeps$IsoFracMW_single <- factor(
    SpeciPeps$IsoFracMW_single,
    sort(as.numeric(unique(SpeciPeps$IsoFracMW_single)))
  )

  SpeciPeps <- SpeciPeps[, {
    se <- unlist(strsplit(.BY$Sequences, ";"))
    sefun <- lapply(se, function(z) {
      xse <- unlist(strsplit(z, split = "_"))
      data.table(Sequence = xse[1], cluster_single = xse[2])
    })
    rbindlist(sefun)
  }, names(SpeciPeps)]

  SpeciPeps$gels <- gsub("^.*.#", "", SpeciPeps$cluster_single)

  # Plot peptides mapped to isoforms
  MSAPlot2 <- ggplot(
    SpeciPeps,
    aes(Position, IsoFracMW_single, color = cluster_single, pch = cluster_single)
  ) +
    geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
    ylab("IsoFrac IsoForms\nIdentified Peptides")

  SpeciPeps$Category_offset <- as.numeric(
    as.character(factor(SpeciPeps$Category, c("new_nterm", "new_cterm", ""), c(-0.5, 1, 0)))
  )

  ra <- range(hu$Position)

  # Annotation for peptide start/end categories
  ano_IF <- geom_vline(
    xintercept = SpeciPeps$Position[grepl("new", SpeciPeps$Category)],
    lty = "dotted",
    color = "red",
    size = 1
  )

  ano_UP <- annotate(
    "text",
    SpeciPeps$Position,
    SpeciPeps$variable,
    label = factor(SpeciPeps$Category, c("new_nterm", "new_cterm"), c(">", "<")),
    color = "red",
    cex = 5
  )

  MSAPlot <- MSAPlot + ano_UP + coord_cartesian(xlim = ra) + ggtitle("Proteins and Pfam Domains")

  # Optional faceting by gel
  if (gelTraces && allgels && facetPlot) {
    MSAPlot2 <- MSAPlot2 + facet_wrap("gels", ncol = 1)
  }

  MSAPlot2 <<- MSAPlot2
  MSAPlot <<- MSAPlot

  # Combine the two panels in one output
  if (invertOrder) {
    ggout <- plot_grid(MSAPlot2, MSAPlot, ncol = 1, align = "hv", rel_heights = c(2, 1.5))
  } else {
    ggout <- plot_grid(
      MSAPlot + ano_UP + coord_cartesian(xlim = ra) + ggtitle("Proteins and Pfam Domains"),
      MSAPlot2 + ano_IF + coord_cartesian(xlim = ra) + ggtitle("Mapped Peptides per IsoFrac Isoform"),
      ncol = 1,
      align = "hv"
    )
  }

  list(
    gg = ggout,
    table = hu,
    SpecIDs = SpeciPeps,
    MSAPlot = MSAPlot + ano_UP + coord_cartesian(xlim = ra),
    MSAPlot2 = MSAPlot2 + ano_IF + coord_cartesian(xlim = ra)
  )
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variant with a Pfam-domain fallback for sequences beginning with M
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
IF_DB_Peptidemapping_modified <- function(
  x,
  IsoFrac_Domain_SequenceAnalysis,
  ProteinSequencesCategories,
  symbol = 19,
  invertOrder = FALSE,
  geli = 1,
  allgels = TRUE,
  facetPlot = TRUE,
  gelTraces = TRUE
) {
  cat("\r", x)

  subsetTable <<- IsoFrac_Domain_SequenceAnalysis[ENS == x]

  if (allgels) {
    subsetTable$HDBscanCluster <- paste(
      subsetTable$HDBscanCluster,
      gsub("_", ".", subsetTable$gels),
      sep = "#"
    )
  } else {
    subsetTable <- subsetTable[grep(c("5per", "8per", "10per")[geli], gels)]
  }

  # Sequences to align
  SEt <- ProteinSequencesCategories[ENSG == x, {
    paste(paste(unique(ProteinID), collapse = ";"), round(mw(.BY$SEQUENCE)), sep = " MW:")
  }, .(SEQUENCE)]

  SE <- SEt$SEQUENCE
  names(SE) <- gsub("_HUMAN", "", SEt$V1)

  dfAlign <- msa::msa(SE, type = "protein", verbose = FALSE, method = "ClustalOmega")
  dff <- as.data.frame(dfAlign@unmasked)

  MatchFun <- lapply(strsplit(dff$x, ""), function(x) {
    sapply(seq_along(x), function(y) {
      if (x[y] != "-") sum(x[1:y] != "-") else 0
    })
  })

  if (length(names(SE)) > 0) {
    names(MatchFun) <- names(dfAlign@unmasked)
  }

  MatchFun <- lapply(MatchFun, function(x) {
    x[x == 0] <- NA
    x
  })

  hu <- as.data.table(MatchFun)
  hu$Position <- seq_len(nrow(hu))
  hu <- melt(hu, id.vars = "Position")
  hu[, MW := as.numeric(gsub(".*.MW:", "", variable)), value]
  hu$variable <- factor(as.character(hu$variable), unique(hu$variable[order(hu$MW)]))

  DomainInfo <- PfamDomainMappingsDomainSequence[ensembl_gene_id == x]
  hu$Domain <- ""

  print("Mapping Domains and Peptide to Protein Sequence")

  for (i in unique(hu$variable)) {
    SEi <- which(names(SE) == i)
    SEsel <- SE[SEi]

    if (length(SEsel) > 0) {
      DomainInfoi <- DomainInfo[SEQUENCE == SEsel]
      if (nrow(DomainInfoi) == 0) {
        # Fallback: try sequence without leading M
        DomainInfoi <- DomainInfo[SEQUENCE == gsub("^M", "", SEsel)]
      }

      if (nrow(DomainInfoi) > 0) {
        Dfun <<- DomainInfoi[, {
          sel <- !is.na(match(hu$value, .BY$pfam_start:.BY$pfam_end)) & hu$variable == i
          hu$Domain[sel] <<- paste(hu$Domain[sel], .BY$Pfam_Description)
          NULL
        }, .(pfam_start, pfam_end, Pfam_Description)]

        if (nrow(Dfun) > 0) {
          stop()
        }
      }
    }

    # Map peptides onto the aligned protein sequence
    selectedP <- subsetTable[ENS == x, ]
    SEsel_IL <- gsub("I", "L", SEsel)

    PeptidesMappings <- selectedP[, {
      gr <- aregexec(.BY$sequence, SEsel_IL)
      gr <- gr[gr > 0]
      if (length(gr) > 0) {
        sapply(gr, function(pos) pos:(pos + nchar(.BY$sequence) - 1))
      } else {
        as.integer(NA)
      }
    }, .(sequence, DomainCategory, ClusterType, Category, IsoFrac_MW, HDBscanCluster)]

    PeptidesMappings$sequence <- paste(PeptidesMappings$sequence, PeptidesMappings$HDBscanCluster, sep = "_")

    PeptidesMappingsCollapsed <- PeptidesMappings[, .(
      Category = paste(unique(Category[Category != "tryptic"]), collapse = ";"),
      Mapped = length(Category),
      IsoFrac = paste(sort(unique(IsoFrac_MW)), collapse = ";"),
      Sequences = paste(unique(sequence), collapse = ";")
    ), V1]

    Posis <- hu$value
    PeptidesMappingsCollapsedMatched <- PeptidesMappingsCollapsed[match(Posis, V1)]

    hu$Category[hu$variable == i] <- PeptidesMappingsCollapsedMatched$Category[hu$variable == i]
    hu$Identified_by_Peptide[hu$variable == i] <- PeptidesMappingsCollapsedMatched$V1[hu$variable == i]
    hu$IsoFracMW[hu$variable == i] <- PeptidesMappingsCollapsedMatched$IsoFrac[hu$variable == i]
    hu$Identified <- !is.na(hu$Identified_by_Peptide)
    hu$Sequences[hu$variable == i] <- PeptidesMappingsCollapsedMatched$Sequences[hu$variable == i]
  }

  hu[, Domain_all := {
    di <- unique(.SD$Domain)
    paste(unique(di), collapse = ";")
  }, Position]

  selectedP_terminal <- hu[Category == "new_nterm" | Category == "new_cterm",
                           .(value = unique(value)),
                           .(IsoFracMW, variable, Category, Position)]

  hu$Domain_all <- gsub("^; ", "", hu$Domain_all)

  MSAPlot <- ggplot(
    hu[!is.na(value)][order(MW)],
    aes(Position, variable, color = Domain_all, size = Identified)
  ) +
    geom_point(pch = symbol, alpha = 0.5) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_viridis_d() +
    ylab("DataBase Entries")

  SpeciPeps <- hu[!is.na(value) & Identified == TRUE, .(
    IsoFracMW_single = { unlist(strsplit(IsoFracMW, ";")) }
  ), .(Position, variable, value, Domain, Category, Identified_by_Peptide, Identified, Domain_all, Sequences)]

  SpeciPeps <- SpeciPeps[, {
    sel <- rep(TRUE, nrow(.SD))
    if (.BY$Category == "new_nterm") sel <- which(Position == min(Position))
    if (.BY$Category == "new_cterm") sel <- which(Position == max(Position))
    .SD[sel]
  }, .(Category, Sequences)]

  SpeciPeps$IsoFracMW_single <- factor(
    SpeciPeps$IsoFracMW_single,
    sort(as.numeric(unique(SpeciPeps$IsoFracMW_single)))
  )

  SpeciPeps <- SpeciPeps[, {
    se <- unlist(strsplit(.BY$Sequences, ";"))
    sefun <- lapply(se, function(z) {
      xse <- unlist(strsplit(z, split = "_"))
      data.table(Sequence = xse[1], cluster_single = xse[2])
    })
    rbindlist(sefun)
  }, names(SpeciPeps)]

  SpeciPeps$gels <- gsub("^.*.#", "", SpeciPeps$cluster_single)

  # Drop a small set of unwanted peptide/isoform combinations
  SpeciPeps <- SpeciPeps[!(
    IsoFracMW_single == "20157" &
      Sequence != "EDGPEGLDK" &
      Sequence != "AMNLDQVSK" &
      Sequence != "QVSSHLQVLAR"
  )]

  MSAPlot2 <- ggplot(
    SpeciPeps,
    aes(Position, IsoFracMW_single, color = cluster_single, pch = cluster_single)
  ) +
    geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
    ylab("IsoFrac IsoForms\nIdentified Peptides")

  SpeciPeps2 <- SpeciPeps[, .(confidence = .N), .(Position, IsoFracMW_single)]
  SpeciPeps2$MWkd <- as.character(round(as.numeric(as.character(SpeciPeps2$IsoFracMW_single)) / 1000, 1))

  # Domain rectangles for compact domain visualization
  huha <<- hu[, as.list(range(Position)), .(variable, Domain)]
  huha <- huha[Domain != ""]

  rects <- data.table(
    xmin = huha$V1,
    xmax = huha$V2,
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = huha$Domain
  )

  MSAPlot3 <- ggplot() +
    geom_rect(
      data = rects[fill != ""],
      aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = fill),
      alpha = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = SpeciPeps2,
      aes(Position, MWkd, color = "identified peptides"),
      pch = "|",
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.5),
      size = 10
    ) +
    ylab("IsoFrac MW [kD]") +
    xlab("Meta Gene Position") +
    scale_color_manual(name = "identified peptides", values = c("black")) +
    theme(legend.title = element_blank())

  SpeciPeps$Category_offset <- as.numeric(
    as.character(factor(SpeciPeps$Category, c("new_nterm", "new_cterm", ""), c(-0.5, 1, 0)))
  )

  ra <- range(hu$Position)

  ano_IF <- geom_vline(
    xintercept = SpeciPeps$Position[grepl("new", SpeciPeps$Category)],
    lty = "dotted",
    color = "red",
    size = 1
  )

  ano_UP <- annotate(
    "text",
    SpeciPeps$Position,
    SpeciPeps$variable,
    label = factor(SpeciPeps$Category, c("new_nterm", "new_cterm"), c(">", "<")),
    color = "red",
    cex = 5
  )

  MSAPlot <- MSAPlot + ano_UP + coord_cartesian(xlim = ra) + ggtitle("Proteins and Pfam Domains")

  if (gelTraces && allgels && facetPlot) {
    MSAPlot2 <- MSAPlot2 + facet_wrap("gels", ncol = 1)
  }

  MSAPlot2 <<- MSAPlot2
  MSAPlot <<- MSAPlot

  if (invertOrder) {
    ggout <- plot_grid(MSAPlot2, MSAPlot, ncol = 1, align = "hv", rel_heights = c(2, 1.5))
  } else {
    ggout <- plot_grid(
      MSAPlot + ano_UP + coord_cartesian(xlim = ra) + ggtitle("Proteins and Pfam Domains"),
      MSAPlot2 + ano_IF + coord_cartesian(xlim = ra) + ggtitle("Mapped Peptides per IsoFrac Isoform"),
      ncol = 1,
      align = "hv"
    )
  }

  list(
    gg = ggout,
    table = hu,
    SpecIDs = SpeciPeps,
    MSAPlot = MSAPlot + ano_UP + coord_cartesian(xlim = ra),
    MSAPlot2 = MSAPlot2 + ano_IF + coord_cartesian(xlim = ra),
    MSAPlot3 = MSAPlot3 + ano_IF + coord_cartesian(xlim = ra)
  )
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read trace intensity profiles directly from the SQLite DB and plot them
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Traces_from_DB <- function(x, dbpath = "../FinalViewer/IsoFrac_0.84/TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks.sqlite", gel = 2) {
  db <- dbConnect(SQLite(), dbpath)
  dbl <- dbListTables(db)

  ensg_vec <- x
  gelSelection <- c("Exp1_5per_Try", "Exp1_8per_Try", "Exp1_10per_Try")[gel]

  zn <- grep("zscore", dbl, value = TRUE)
  zn <- grep(gelSelection, zn, value = TRUE)

  hr <- grep("hdbscanTables_", dbListTables(db), value = TRUE)
  hr <- grep(gelSelection, hr, value = TRUE)

  mw <- grep("Fractions_MW", dbl, value = TRUE)
  mw <- grep(gelSelection, mw, value = TRUE)

  if (length(hr) > 1) {
    print("Too many selected candidates, picking first entry.")
    hr <- hr[1]
    zn <- zn[1]
  }

  hdbscans <- data.table(dbGetQuery(
    db,
    paste("SELECT * FROM", paste("'", hr, "'", sep = ""), "WHERE EnsG = ", paste("'", ensg_vec, "'", sep = ""))
  ))

  IdentifiedPeaks_Table <- data.table(dbGetQuery(
    db,
    paste("SELECT * FROM IdentifiedPeaks_Table WHERE Ens=", paste("'", ensg_vec, "'", sep = ""))
  ))

  # Read z-score traces for each cluster row
  zscore <- lapply(hdbscans$id, function(x) {
    dbGetQuery(
      db,
      paste("SELECT * FROM", paste("'", zn, "'", sep = ""), "LIMIT 1 OFFSET", x - 1)
    )
  })

  zscoredt <- rbindlist(zscore)
  zscoredt$id <- hdbscans$id
  zscoredt$cl <- hdbscans$cl_2
  zscoredt$Seq <- hdbscans$Seq

  zscoredt_melt <- melt(zscoredt, id.vars = c("id", "cl", "Seq"))

  # Add molecular weight axis for fraction positions
  mwDT <- dbReadTable(db, mw)
  zscoredt_melt$MW <- mwDT[as.numeric(gsub("V", "", zscoredt_melt$variable)), 1]

  CPP <<- data.table(dbGetQuery(
    db,
    paste("SELECT * FROM Compressed_Pairs WHERE ENS=", paste("'", ensg_vec, "'", sep = ""))
  ))

  dbDisconnect(db)

  plotlyScale <- c("#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c", "#d62728", "#9467bd",
                   "#8c564b", "#e377c2", "#7f7f7f", "#bcbd22", "#17becf")

  zscoredt_melt$color <- rev(plotlyScale)[as.numeric(zscoredt_melt$cl) + 1]

  ggplot(zscoredt_melt, aes(10^MW, value, group = id, color = cl)) +
    geom_line(lwd = 1) +
    annotate(
      "segment",
      x = 10^CPP$MW_lm_gel_lo,
      xend = 10^CPP$MW_lm_gel_hi,
      y = CPP$Height,
      yend = CPP$Height,
      cex = 1,
      color = "grey"
    ) +
    annotate("text", 10^CPP$MW_lm, CPP$Height, label = "*", cex = 15, color = "red")
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Extract one gene's data bundle from the SQLite DB for downstream plotting
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Extract_IsoFrac_Info <- function(ROC, input) {
  print("Connecting")
  db <- dbConnect(SQLite(), dbPath)

  print("Checking")
  gnhu <<- input$GN
  if (gnhu == "") {
    return(NULL)
  }

  dt_gn_all <<- data.table(dbReadTable(db, "GN"))
  dt_gn_sel <- dt_gn_all[gel == input$inputtable]

  gnpos <- which(dt_gn_sel$ens == input$GN)

  dataset_init <- list()

  # Input table for this gene / gel
  tabname <<- paste("TMTSubset_final_singlenorm_zscore", input$inputtable, sep = "_#_")
  temp <- dbReadTable(db, tabname)
  TMTValues <- data.table(temp[gnpos, ])
  dataset_init$inputtable <- TMTValues

  # MW information
  tabname <- paste("Protein_MW", input$inputtable, sep = "_#_")
  dataset_init$Protein_MW <- dbReadTable(db, tabname)

  tabname <- paste("Fractions_MW", input$inputtable, sep = "_#_")
  dataset_init$Fractions_MW <- dbReadTable(db, tabname)

  tabname <- paste("hdbscanTables", input$inputtable, sep = "_#_")
  dataset_init$hdbscanTables <- data.table(dbGetQuery(
    db,
    paste("SELECT * FROM", paste("'", tabname, "'", sep = ""), "WHERE EnsG = ", paste("'", input$GN, "'", sep = ""))
  ))

  # Make cluster labels compatible
  d <- dataset_init$hdbscanTables
  nonzeros <- d$BestCluster[d$BestCluster != "0"]
  nonzeros <- c(0, unique(d$BestCluster))
  nonzeros[is.na(nonzeros)] <- 0
  d$BestCluster <- factor(d$BestCluster, unique(nonzeros))
  dataset_init$hdbscanTables <- d

  dataset_init$ID <- gnpos
  dataset_init$dt_gn <- dt_gn_sel[gnpos]

  # Pair tables
  dataset_init$IdentifiedPeaks_Table <- data.table(dbGetQuery(
    db,
    paste(
      "SELECT * FROM IdentifiedPeaks_Table WHERE Ens=",
      paste("'", input$GN, "'", sep = ""),
      "AND gel=",
      paste("'", input$inputtable, "'", sep = "")
    )
  ), integer64 = "double")

  dataset_init$CombinedGels_Pairs_Filtered <- data.table(dbGetQuery(
    db,
    paste("SELECT * FROM CombinedGels_Pairs_Filtered WHERE ENS =", paste("'", input$GN, "'", sep = ""))
  ), integer64 = "double")

  dataset_init$CombinedGels_Pairs_Filtered_PB <- data.table(dbGetQuery(
    db,
    paste("SELECT * FROM CombinedGels_Pairs_Filtered_PACBIO WHERE ENS =", paste("'", input$GN, "'", sep = ""))
  ), integer64 = "double")

  dataset_init$Pairs_Filtered_Compressed <- data.table(dbGetQuery(
    db,
    paste("SELECT * FROM CombinedGels_Compressed_Pairs WHERE ENS =", paste("'", input$GN, "'", sep = ""))
  ), integer64 = "double")

  # Peak results table
  dataset_init$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable <- DF_numericClass(data.table(dbGetQuery(
    db,
    paste(
      "SELECT * FROM IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable WHERE ENS =",
      paste("'", input$GN, "'", sep = ""),
      "AND gel =",
      paste("'", input$inputtable, "'", sep = "")
    )
  )))

  # Keep only peaks that match the compressed-pair definitions
  tempPeaks <- dataset_init$Pairs_Filtered_Compressed[, {
    gr <- lapply(.BY, as.character)
    hu <- lapply(gr, strsplit, split = ";")
    names(hu) <- paste(names(hu), "split", sep = "_")
    hu$Compressed_MW_Variants <- .GRP
    lapply(hu, unlist)
  }, .(gels, clusters, heights, Peaks_collapse, MW_lm)]

  tempPeaks <- tempPeaks[gels_split == input$inputtable]
  tempPeaks$cluster2 <- tempPeaks$clusters_split
  tempPeaks$MW_lm_Compressed_ <- tempPeaks$MW_lm

  dataset_init$IdentifiedPeaks_Table <- dataset_init$IdentifiedPeaks_Table[
    !is.na(match(Peak, tempPeaks$Peaks_collapse_split)) &
      !is.na(match(cluster2, tempPeaks$clusters_split))
  ]

  dbDisconnect(db)
  dataset_init
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Coerce columns that are mostly numeric into numeric
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DF_numericClass <- function(x) {
  hum <- sapply(x, function(col) {
    n_na_before <- sum(is.na(col))
    n_na_after <- sum(is.na(as.numeric(col)))
    n_na_after > n_na_before
  })

  df <- as.data.frame(x)
  for (i in which(!hum)) {
    class(df[, i]) <- "numeric"
  }
  df
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot fraction-wise peptide intensity traces, with optional cluster averaging
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Traces_Plotly <- function(
  input_data,
  mpwcutoff = 0,
  converttoMW = TRUE,
  IntensityCutoff = 0.1,
  cbPalette = c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7"),
  PurePlot = FALSE,
  showlegend = TRUE,
  MeanCluster = FALSE,
  ShowQuantiles = TRUE,
  addPolygon = TRUE,
  linelwd = 2,
  vjust_value = -2,
  StarSize = 5
) {
  input_data <<- input_data

  ens <- paste(unique(input_data$dt_gn$ens, input_data$dt_gn$hgnc_symbol), collapse = "")
  hdb <- input_data$hdbscanTables
  tempValues <- input_data$inputtable
  hdb <- hdb[match(input_data$ID, hdb$id), ]

  # Attach cluster labels to fraction matrix
  tempValues$cl <- as.numeric(as.character(hdb$cl_2))
  vec <- 0:max(tempValues$cl, na.rm = TRUE)
  tempValues$cl <- factor(tempValues$cl, vec, c("noise traces", vec[-1]))
  tempValues$id <- hdb$id

  # Melt fraction table into long format
  if (any(grepl("^V[0-9]", colnames(tempValues)[1]))) {
    me <- melt(tempValues, measure.vars = paste("V", 1:28, sep = ""), id.vars = c("cl", "id"))
    me$variable <- as.numeric(gsub("V", "", me$variable))
  } else {
    colnames(tempValues) <- gsub("X", "", colnames(tempValues))
    me <- melt(tempValues, measure.vars = as.character(2:29), id.vars = c("cl", "id"))
    me$variable <- as.numeric(as.character(me$variable))
    me$variable <- me$variable - min(me$variable)
  }

  me <- me[!is.na(variable)]

  # Convert fraction indices to MW if requested
  if (length(input_data$Fractions_MW$x.Fractions_predicted_MW) > 0 && converttoMW) {
    mds <- input_data$Fractions_MW$x.Fractions_predicted_MW[1:28]
    me$variable <- 10^mds[match(me$variable, 1:28)]
  }

  # Add a terminal NA row to visually break traces
  me <- rbind(me, me[, .(value = max(value) + 1, variable = NA), .(id, cl)])

  me$cl <- factor(me$cl)
  me$seq <- input_data$dt_gn$seq[match(me$id, input_data$ID)]

  me <- me[order(id, variable)]
  me[, idtemp := .GRP, .(cl, id)]
  try(me <- me[order(as.numeric(idtemp))], silent = TRUE)
  try(me <- me[order(as.character(seq))], silent = TRUE)
  try(me <- me[order(as.numeric(cl))], silent = TRUE)
  try(me <- me[order(as.numeric(id))], silent = TRUE)

  # Hide duplicate legend entries
  idCount <- 0
  idRemove <- c()
  for (i in unique(me$cl)) {
    ids <- unique(me[cl == i]$id)
    ids <- seq_along(ids) + idCount
    idCount <- max(ids)
    idRemove <- c(idRemove, ids[-1])
  }

  # Optionally average all traces within each cluster
  if (MeanCluster) {
    me <- me[, .(
      value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      q90 = quantile(value, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE),
      q10 = quantile(value, 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = length(value),
      seq = paste(unique(seq), collapse = "\n"),
      idtemp = .GRP,
      id = .GRP
    ), .(cl, variable)]
  }

  cbp <- colorRampPalette(cbPalette)(max(as.numeric(me$cl), na.rm = TRUE))
  cbp <- c("#73FDFF", cbp)

  if (PurePlot) {
    cbp <- "#00000080"
    me$color <- "black"
    me$name <- ""
    me$legendgroup <- ""
  } else {
    me$color <- cbp[as.numeric(as.character(me$cl)) + 1]
  }

  me$q90a <- me$q90
  me$q10a <- me$q10

  if (ShowQuantiles && MeanCluster) {
    me$q90 <- abs(me$q90 - me$value)
    me$q10 <- abs(me$value - me$q10)
  } else {
    me$q90 <- NA
    me$q10 <- NA
  }

  me <- me[!is.na(cl) & !is.na(value)]

  # Static ggplot representation
  g2 <- ggplot(me, aes(as.numeric(variable) / 1000, value, group = id, color = as.character(cl))) +
    geom_line(lwd = linelwd)

  # Overlay peak positions
  Peaks <- input_data$Pairs_Filtered_Compressed
  PeaksCheck <<- Peaks
  Peaks <- Peaks[Intensity > IntensityCutoff]

  Peaks[, c("Peak", "Start", "End") := .(
    Peak = 10^as.numeric(MW_lm_Compressed_) / 1000,
    Start = 10^as.numeric(Start_MW) / 1000,
    End = 10^as.numeric(End_MW) / 1000
  ), MW_lm_Compressed_]

  xcutoff <- 5
  Peaks[, c("Start", "End") := {
    if (abs(Start - Peak) > xcutoff) Start <- Peak - xcutoff
    if (abs(Peak - End) > xcutoff) End <- Peak + xcutoff
    list(Start, End)
  }, MW_lm_Compressed_]

  g2 <- g2 +
    annotate(
      "pointrange",
      x = Peaks$Peak,
      y = as.numeric(Peaks$Height),
      xmin = Peaks$Start,
      xmax = Peaks$End,
      colour = "grey",
      size = 2.5,
      shape = NA,
      linewidth = 1.5
    ) +
    annotate(
      "point",
      x = 10^as.numeric(Peaks$MW_lm_Compressed_) / 1000,
      y = as.numeric(Peaks$Height),
      color = "red",
      bg = "red",
      shape = 24,
      size = StarSize,
      lwd = 20
    ) +
    annotate(
      "point",
      x = 10^as.numeric(Peaks$MW_lm_Compressed_) / 1000,
      y = as.numeric(Peaks$Height),
      color = "red",
      bg = "red",
      shape = 25,
      size = StarSize,
      lwd = 20
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = 10^as.numeric(Peaks$MW_lm_Compressed_) / 1000,
      y = as.numeric(Peaks$Height),
      label = round(10^as.numeric(Peaks$MW_lm_Compressed_) / 1000, 1),
      vjust = vjust_value,
      hjust = 0.5,
      color = "red",
      bg = "red",
      shape = 25,
      size = 5,
      lwd = 20
    ) +
    ylab("peptide intensity trace [zscore]") +
    xlab("MW [kD]") +
    ggplot2::scale_color_viridis_d()

  # Interactive plotly version
  p <- plot_ly(
    me,
    x = ~variable,
    y = ~value,
    color = ~cl,
    name = ~cl,
    legendgroup = ~cl,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines",
    hoverinfo = "text",
    text = me$seq,
    colors = cbp,
    line = list(width = 3)
  ) %>%
    layout(showlegend = TRUE)

  p <- try(p %>% style(showlegend = FALSE, traces = idRemove), silent = TRUE)

  # Optional cluster envelope polygons
  if (addPolygon && MeanCluster) {
    for (i in unique(me$cl)) {
      mei <- me[cl == i]
      mei <- mei[order(variable, decreasing = TRUE)]
      mei <- mei[!is.na(variable)]
      mei$color[is.na(mei$color)] <- "#73FDFF"

      p <- p %>% add_polygons(
        x = c(mei$variable, rev(mei$variable), mei$variable[1]),
        y = c(mei$q90a, rev(mei$q10a), mei$q90a[1]),
        line = list(width = 2, color = "transparent"),
        fillcolor = paste(mei$color[1], 20, sep = ""),
        inherit = FALSE,
        legendgroup = mei$cl[1],
        name = "0.1 to 0.9 Q"
      )
    }
  }

  p <- p %>%
    layout(
      title = ens,
      xaxis = list(title = "MW converted fraction"),
      yaxis = list(title = "zscore"),
      legend = list(title = list(text = "Peptide Clusters")),
      showlegend = showlegend
    )

  list(p = p, g = g2, data = me, clusterColors = cbp)
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Alternative plotly wrapper with explicit coloring/filtering controls
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Traces_Plotly2 <- function(
  input,
  ens = "ENSG00000120802",
  mpwcutoff = 0,
  converttoMW = TRUE,
  cbPalette = c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7"),
  PurePlot = FALSE,
  showlegend = TRUE,
  MeanCluster = FALSE,
  ShowQuantiles = TRUE,
  colorClusters = NULL,
  colorSequences = NULL
) {
  ens <<- ens

  hdb <- input$hdbscanTables[EnsG == ens]
  tempValues <- input$TMTSubset_final_singlenorm_zscore[hdb$id, ]

  tempValues$cl <- hdb$cl_2
  tempValues$id <- hdb$id
  tempValues$sequences <- hdb$Seq

  if (any(grepl("^V[0-9]", colnames(tempValues)[1]))) {
    me <- melt(tempValues, measure.vars = paste("V", 1:28, sep = ""), id.vars = c("cl", "id"))
    me$variable <- as.numeric(gsub("V", "", me$variable))
  } else {
    me <- melt(tempValues, measure.vars = as.character(2:29), id.vars = c("cl", "id"))
    me$variable <- as.numeric(as.character(me$variable))
    me$variable <- me$variable - min(me$variable) + 1
  }

  if (length(input$Fractions_predicted_MW) > 0 && converttoMW) {
    mds <- input$Fractions_predicted_MW[1:28]
    me$variable <- 10^mds[match(me$variable, 1:28)]
  }

  # Add a terminal NA row to break traces
  me <- rbind(
    me,
    me[, .(value = max(value, na.rm = TRUE) + 1, variable = NA), .(id, cl)],
    fill = TRUE
  )

  me$cl <- factor(me$cl)
  me$seq <- input$dt_gn$seq[me$id]
  me$match <- 0

  me <- me[order(id, variable)]
  me[, idtemp := .GRP, .(cl, id)]
  try(me <- me[order(idtemp)], silent = TRUE)
  try(me <- me[order(seq)], silent = TRUE)
  try(me <- me[order(cl)], silent = TRUE)
  try(me <- me[order(id)], silent = TRUE)

  # Hide duplicate legend entries
  idCount <- 0
  idRemove <- c()
  for (i in unique(me$cl)) {
    ids <- unique(me[cl == i]$id)
    ids <- seq_along(ids) + idCount
    idCount <- max(ids)
    idRemove <- c(idRemove, ids[-1])
  }

  if (MeanCluster) {
    print(dim(me))
    me <- me[, .(
      value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
      q90 = quantile(value, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE),
      q10 = quantile(value, 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = length(value),
      seq = paste(unique(seq), collapse = "\n"),
      idtemp = .GRP,
      id = .GRP
    ), .(cl, variable)]
    print(dim(me))
  }

  cbp <- colorRampPalette(cbPalette)(max(as.character(me$cl)))
  cbp <- c("#73FDFF", cbp)
  alphaset <- NULL

  if (PurePlot) {
    cbp <- "#A9A9A9"
    me$color <- cbp
    me$name <- ""
    me$legendgroup <- ""
    me$match <- 0

    if (length(colorClusters) > 0) {
      sel <- !is.na(match(me$cl, colorClusters))
      me$color <- sel
      me$match <- as.numeric(sel)
      cbp <- c(cbp, "tomato")
      alphaset <- 0.7
    }

    if (length(colorSequences) > 0) {
      sel <- !is.na(match(me$seq, colorSequences))
      me$match <- as.numeric(sel)
      me$color <- sel
      cbp <- c(cbp, "tomato")
      alphaset <- 0.7
      me$alphaset <- c(0.2, 1)[as.numeric(sel) + 1]
    }
  } else {
    me$color <- cbp[as.numeric(as.character(me$cl)) + 1]
  }

  if (ShowQuantiles && MeanCluster) {
    me$q90 <- me$q90 - me$value
    me$q10 <- me$value - me$q10
  } else {
    me$q90 <- NA
    me$q10 <- NA
  }

  me <- me[order(match, decreasing = FALSE)]
  meleftover <- me[match != 0]

  if (any(me$match > 0)) {
    clvec <- c(unique(me[match == 0]$cl), unique(me[match > 0]$cl))
    colvec <- c(unique(me[match == 0]$color), unique(me[match > 0]$color))
    me$cl <- factor(me$cl, clvec)
    me$color <- factor(me$color, colvec)
  }

  me <- me[match == 0]

  p <- plot_ly(
    me,
    x = ~variable,
    y = ~value,
    color = ~color,
    name = ~cl,
    legendgroup = ~cl,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "lines",
    hoverinfo = "text",
    text = me,
    colors = cbp,
    line = list(width = 3),
    alpha = alphaset,
    error_y = list(
      type = "data",
      symmetric = FALSE,
      array = ~q90,
      arrayminus = ~q10,
      width = 2
    )
  ) %>%
    layout(showlegend = TRUE)

  try(p <- p %>% style(showlegend = FALSE, traces = idRemove), silent = TRUE)

  if (nrow(meleftover) > 0) {
    p <- p %>% add_trace(
      x = meleftover$variable,
      y = meleftover$value,
      color = meleftover$color,
      name = meleftover$cl,
      legendgroup = meleftover$cl,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines",
      hoverinfo = "text",
      text = meleftover$seq,
      colors = cbp,
      line = list(width = 3),
      alpha = 1,
      error_y = list(
        type = "data",
        symmetric = FALSE,
        array = meleftover$q90,
        arrayminus = meleftover$q10,
        width = 2
      ),
      toback = TRUE
    )
  }

  p <- p %>%
    layout(
      title = ens,
      xaxis = list(title = "MW converted fraction"),
      yaxis = list(title = "zscore"),
      legend = list(title = list(text = "hdbscan results")),
      showlegend = showlegend
    )

  me$Group <- as.character(me$cl)

  if (!PurePlot) {
    g2 <- ggplot(me[!is.na(variable) & cl != 0 & cl != -1], aes(as.numeric(variable) / 1000, value, group = id, color = Group)) +
      geom_line()
  } else {
    g2 <- ggplot(me[!is.na(variable) & cl != 0 & cl != -1], aes(as.numeric(variable) / 1000, value, group = id)) +
      geom_line(color = "black", alpha = 0.5, lwd = 1)
  }

  list(p = p, data = me, clusterColors = cbp, g2 = g2)
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Base ggplot version of the trace plot
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Traces_GGplot <- function(input, ens = "ENSG00000120802", mpwcutoff = 0, converttoMW = TRUE, PurePlot = TRUE, showlegend = FALSE) {
  hdb <- input$hdbscanTables[EnsG == ens]
  tempValues <- input$TMTSubset_final_singlenorm_zscore[hdb$id, ]

  tempValues$cl <- hdb$cl_2
  tempValues$id <- hdb$id

  if (any(grepl("^V[0-9]", colnames(tempValues)[1]))) {
    me <- melt(tempValues, measure.vars = paste("V", 1:28, sep = ""), id.vars = c("cl", "id"))
    me$variable <- as.numeric(gsub("V", "", me$variable))
  } else {
    me <- melt(tempValues, measure.vars = 2:29, id.vars = c("cl", "id"))
  }

  if (length(input$MW_Predictor) > 0 && converttoMW) {
    md <- input$MW_Predictor
    mds <- 10^predict(md, 2:29)
    me$variable <- mds[match(me$variable, 2:29)]
  }

  if (PurePlot) {
    g2 <- ggplot(me, aes(as.numeric(variable), value, group = id, color = as.character(cl))) +
      geom_line(color = "black")
  } else {
    g2 <- ggplot(me, aes(as.numeric(variable), value, group = id, color = as.character(cl))) +
      geom_line()
  }

  list(p = g2 + xlab("MW") + ylab("zscore") + ggtitle(ens), data = me, clusterColors = NA)
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Draw sequence letters underneath cluster-colored positions
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
plot.sequence <- function(IFUN, selected = IFUN$ENSEMBL_PROTEIN[1], ClustColor = NULL, ProtSequence = NULL) {
  ClustColor <<- ClustColor
  IFUN <<- IFUN
  selected <<- selected
  ProtSequence <<- ProtSequence

  it <- 1
  IFUN$Sequence <- IFUN$Seq
  IFUN$Cluster <- IFUN$cl_2

  ClustColorMatch <- ClustColor[match(IFUN$Cluster, ClustColor$cluster2), ]
  IFUN$Color <- ClustColorMatch$Color

  if (length(IFUN$Color) == 0) {
    IFUN$Color <- "grey"
    IFUN$color <- "grey"
  }

  IFUN$Peaks <- ClustColorMatch$V1

  Positions <- IFUN[, {
    sequ <- .BY$Sequence
    gr <- gregexpr(sequ, ProtSequence, fixed = TRUE)
    Posis <- gr[[1]]:(gr[[1]] + attributes(gr[[1]])$match.length - 1)
    data.table(Position = Posis)
  }, .(Sequence, Cluster, Color)]

  Positions$Color[is.na(Positions$Color)] <- "black"
  Positions <- Positions[, .(co = paste(unique(Color), collapse = ";"), cl = paste(unique(Cluster), collapse = ";")), Position]
  Positions <- Positions[Position > 0 & !is.na(Position)]

  LE <- strsplit(ProtSequence, "")
  maxLe <- 40
  yrow <- ceiling(length(LE[[1]]) / maxLe)[it]

  vec <<- rep(0, yrow * maxLe)
  vec[Positions$Position] <- Positions$cl
  try({
    vec <- as.numeric(factor(as.character(vec), unique(vec), 1:length(unique(vec))))
  })
  vec[is.na(vec)] <- 0
  vec <<- vec

  MA <- matrix(rev(vec), nrow = yrow, ncol = maxLe, byrow = TRUE)
  MA <- apply(MA, 1, rev)

  par(mai = c(0.8, 0.1, 0.5, 2))
  image(MA, main = "", col = c("#FFFFFF", ClustColor$Color), axes = FALSE)
  mtext(selected, 3, line = 1)

  ClustColorLeg <- unique(ClustColor)
  ClustColorLeg$cluster2 <- NULL

  legend(
    par()$usr[2], par()$usr[4],
    xjust = 0,
    legend = c(as.character(ClustColorLeg$V1), ">x"),
    fill = c(ClustColorLeg$Color, "#33333340"),
    xpd = NA,
    bty = "n",
    cex = 0.8
  )

  legend(
    par()$usr[1], par()$usr[3],
    xjust = 0,
    legend = c(as.character(ClustColorLeg$V1), ">x"),
    fill = c(ClustColorLeg$Color, "#33333340"),
    horiz = TRUE,
    xpd = NA,
    bty = "n"
  )

  y <<- 0
  x <<- 0
  sapply(seq_along(LE[[it]]), function(ite) {
    text(x / (maxLe - 1), 1 - y / (yrow - 1), LE[[it]][ite], xpd = NA)
    x <<- x + 1
    if (x %% maxLe == 0) {
      y <<- y + 1
      x <<- 0
    }
  })
}

#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Map peptide evidence from a plot object onto protein sequences
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
MappedProteinSequences <- function(P, IDs, TotalWidth = 50) {
  P$data$Sequence <- P$data$seq
  P$data$Cluster <- P$data$cl
  P$data$Color <- P$data$cl

  MappedData <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(IDs)), function(it) {
    ProtSequence <- IDs$SEQUENCE[it]
    P$data$SequenceComparisson <- ProtSequence

    singlefun <- strsplit(ProtSequence, "")
    dt <- data.table(
      Sequence = "",
      Cluster = -1,
      Color = -1,
      Position = seq_along(unlist(singlefun)),
      AA = unlist(singlefun),
      ProtSequence = ProtSequence
    )

    Positions <- P$data[, {
      sequ <<- .BY$Sequence
      gr <- gregexpr(sequ, ProtSequence, fixed = TRUE)
      Posis <- gr[[1]]:(gr[[1]] + attributes(gr[[1]])$match.length - 1)
      data.table(Position = Posis)
    }, .(Sequence, Cluster, Color)]

    po <- Positions$Position
    po[po < 1] <- NA
    Positions$ProtSequence <- ProtSequence
    Positions$AA <- singlefun[[1]][po]

    PositionsCombi <- rbind(dt, Positions)
    PositionsCombi$ProtName <- IDs$ProteinID[it]
    PositionsCombi
  })

  MappedData <- rbindlist(MappedData)
  MappedData$Color[is.na(MappedData$Color)] <- -1

  # Lay out positions in rows of fixed width
  MappedDataAdjusted <- MappedData[, {
    temp <- .SD
    temp <- temp[!is.na(temp$AA)]
    Row <- ceiling(temp$Position / TotalWidth)
    Col <- temp$Position - TotalWidth * (Row - 1)
    temp$x <- Col
    temp$y <- Row
    temp
  }, .(ProtSequence, ProtName)]

  MappedDataAdjusted
}

# Helper Function, extracts x and y ranges from ggplot objects
get_ggplot_ranges <- function(p){
  b <- ggplot_build(p)
  
  lapply(b$layout$panel_params, function(x){
    list(
      x = x$x.range,
      y = x$y.range
    )
  })
}
```


## SimilarityTables across all Gels

Similar to the UniProt based peak assignment, this chunk builds the cross-gel similarity analysis used for the manuscript figure 4 with the PACBIO database instead of UniProt database. It prepares a non-redundant protein sequence table, combines the compressed peak assignments across gels, and then runs the enrichment-based network assignment step for every gene. 

```{r,cache=F}
## SimilarityTables across all gels

  # Run the enrichment wrapper for every ENSG
```

## -> Trains Based on gbm UniProt Model

This section loads the pre-trained GBM (UniProt) model, scores both the UniProt and PacBIO candidate tables, assigns the GBM score as the reference score, combines both datasets for downstream comparison, and saves the updated result objects for later use.

```{r}
## Train GBM scoring model on the UniProt reference and score both datasets

# Add a simple UniProt fraction feature used by the model
AddTotalUniprotFraction <- function(x) {
  x$TotalUniprotFraction <- as.numeric(x$All_Uniprot_Peptides) / as.numeric(x$all_sequences)
  x
}

Results_CombinedGels_PacBio$Pairs_Unfiltered_PacBio <-

# Helper to predict scores with an H2O model
PredictScores <- function(x, md) {
  x <- copy(x)
  names(x) <- make.unique(names(x))
  x$V1 <- NULL
  xh <- as.h2o(x)
  as.data.frame(predict(md, xh))$predict
}

# Prepare UniProt table for scoring

Results_CombinedGels_PacBio$Pairs_Unfiltered_PacBio$DataType <- "PB"
``` 

## ROC Combi

This section evaluates how well the combined PacBIO/UniProt model separates forward (fw) from reverse (rv) hits using ROC curves. It builds ROC analyses for the main ranking features (dhyper_p, overlap measures, and the GBM score), estimates AUC stability by bootstrap resampling, and stores both the ROC curves and AUC summaries for plotting and downstream use.

```{r ROC allGels before filtering}
## ROC analysis for combined datasets (PacBIO + UniProt)

# Combine filtered results from different scoring strategies
BestMatchdt <- rbindlist(Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$Pairs_Filtered_list)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Function: Generate ROC curves for selected features
# --------------------------------------------------
RocGenerator <- function(FeatureInput,
                         SelectedColumns = c("dhyper_p",
                                             "IsofracOverlap",
                                             "UniprotOverlap",
                                             "all_sequences",
                                             "type",
                                             "score_ref_PacBIO")) {
  
  # Subset relevant features
  FeatureSelect <- FeatureInput[, .SD, .SDcols = SelectedColumns]
  
  # Rename columns for readability
  setnames(
    FeatureSelect,
    c("dhyper_p", "IsofracOverlap", "UniprotOverlap", "score_UP_gb"),
    c("Overlap", "Coverage Isofrac", "Coverage Uniprot", "ML Score")
  )
  
  # Define binary classification (fw = TRUE positives)
  typevec <- FeatureSelect$type == "fw"
  FeatureSelect$type <- NULL
  
  # Counter for feature names
  it <- 0
  
  # --------------------------------------------------
  # Compute ROC curves per feature
  # --------------------------------------------------
  rocs <- apply(FeatureSelect, 2, function(x) {
    
    it <<- it + 1
    
    # ROC calculation
    pos <- pROC::roc(typevec, as.numeric(x))
    
    # Bootstrap AUC estimation (10 iterations)
    aucs <- sapply(1:10, function(i) {
      sa <- sample(seq_along(x), length(x), replace = TRUE)
      
      if (length(unique(typevec[sa])) == 2) {
        pos_bs <- pROC::roc(typevec[sa], as.numeric(x[sa]))
        return(pos_bs$auc)
      } else {
        return(NA_real_)
      }
    })
    
    # Return ROC object + AUC statistics
    list(
      q = quantile(aucs, probs = c(0.05, 0.5, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE),
      pos = pos,
      feature = colnames(FeatureSelect)[it]
    )
  })
  
  # Convert ROC curves into plotting table
  rocs_d <- rbindlist(lapply(rocs, function(x) {
    data.table(
      Specificity = x$pos$specificities,
      Sensitivity = x$pos$sensitivities,
      feature = paste(x$feature, round(x$pos$auc, 2))
    )
  }))
  
  return(rocs_d)
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Generate ROC curves using GBM score
# --------------------------------------------------
ROCSall <- lapply(c("score_UP_gb"), function(score_col) {
  
  ROC_Combi <- RocGenerator(
    CombiScoreTable,
    SelectedColumns = c("dhyper_p",
                        "IsofracOverlap",
                        "UniprotOverlap",
                        "type",
                        score_col)
  )
  
  ROC_Combi$ROC_TYPE <- score_col
  ROC_Combi
})

names(ROCSall) <- c("score_UP_gb")

# --------------------------------------------------
# Plot ROC curves
# --------------------------------------------------
ROCplot <- function(x) {
  
  # Order features for consistent plotting
  x$feature <- factor(
    x$feature,
    c(
      grep("Isofrac", x$feature, value = TRUE)[1],
      grep("Uniprot", x$feature, value = TRUE)[1],
      grep("Overlap", x$feature, value = TRUE)[1],
      grep("Score", x$feature, value = TRUE)[1]
    )
  )
  
  ggplot(x, aes(Specificity, Sensitivity, color = feature)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    xlim(1, 0) +                                 # reverse axis (ROC style)
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 1, lty = "dotted") +
    facet_wrap("ROC_TYPE")
}

# Save ROC plots
pdf("ROCS.pdf", width = 10)
do.call(plot_grid, lapply(ROCSall, ROCplot))
dev.off()

system("open ROCS.pdf")

# --------------------------------------------------
# Compute AUC using trapezoidal integration
# --------------------------------------------------
ROCSalldt <- rbindlist(ROCSall)

library(pracma)

BP_AUC <- ROCSalldt[, {
  trapz(Specificity, Sensitivity)
}, by = .(ROC_TYPE, feature)]

# Store AUC summary
Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$ROC_BP <- list(
  table = ROCSalldt,
  gg = ggplot(BP_AUC, aes(feature, V1, fill = ROC_TYPE)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Clean ROC table for final plotting
# --------------------------------------------------
ROCtable <- ROCSall$score_UP_gb[
  !grepl("all_sequences", feature)
]

ROCtable$feature <- gsub("UniprotOverlap", "Database Overlap", ROCtable$feature)

# Final ROC plot
Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$ROC <- ggplot(
  ROCtable,
  aes(Specificity, Sensitivity, color = feature)
) +
  geom_line() +
  xlim(1, 0) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 1, lty = "dotted")

# Save results
save(Results_CombinedGels_PBUP, file = "Results_CombinedGels_PBUP.rda")
save(ROCSall, file = "ROCSall.rda")

```

## PACBIO vs UniProt: Comparative Isoform Assignment and Delta Mass-Based Classification

This section compares PacBIO and UniProt assignments after harmonizing the combined result tables. For each isoform pair, the best UniProt and PacBIO scores were extracted, and only high-confidence cases were retained using a score threshold of 0.8. Delta masses for UniProt and PacBIO candidates were then compared, and each pair was assigned to one of several interpretation bins based on whether the masses agreed, differed in sign, or fell near the diagonal in an orthogonal distance framework. Protein-level annotations were mapped back to UniProt category labels and condensed into broader isoform classes. The resulting tables were used to summarize database-specific isoform counts, score ratios, delta-mass categories, and enrichment of UniProt and PacBIO category types with hypergeometric testing, with multiple-testing correction applied by BH adjustment.

```{r}
## ->> Trying with orthogonal distance calculation Ran on 20260312

if (!exists("plotCollecter")) {
  plotCollecter <- list()
}

if (!exists("Results_CombinedGels_PBUP")) {

}

}

plotCollecter$PBUP_IsoFormCountCategoriesBoxplots$Caption <-
  "Boxplots between PB and UP within different isoform-quality bins."

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build row-wise comparison table for downstream distance / category logic
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
RowWiseCompare <- Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$Pairs_Filtered[type == "fw"]

# Carry over UniProt isoform category from the UniProt-only table

  Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered$UniProt_Category[
    match(RowWiseCompare$Uniprot, Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered$Uniprot)

# Mark rows with unassigned UniProt category as PACBIO
RowWiseCompare$Uniprot_Isoform_Category[!is.na(RowWiseCompare$Uniprot_Isoform_Category)] <- "PACBIO"

# Add gene symbol
RowWiseCompare$hgnc <- dt_gn_uni$uni_hgnc[match(RowWiseCompare$ENSG, dt_gn_uni$ens)]

# Parse best score values from semicolon-separated score fields
RowWiseCompare$score_ref_Uniprot <-
  sapply(strsplit(RowWiseCompare$score_UP_gb_UP, ";"),
         function(x) max(as.numeric(x), na.rm = TRUE))

RowWiseCompare$score_ref_PacBIO <-
  sapply(strsplit(RowWiseCompare$score_UP_gb_PB, ";"),
         function(x) max(as.numeric(x), na.rm = TRUE))

# Thresholds used later
scoreCutoff <- c(0.8, 2)
dmDiff <- 10000

RowWiseCompare$CombiScore_Uniprot <- as.numeric(RowWiseCompare$score_ref_Uniprot)
RowWiseCompare$Combiscore_ref      <- as.numeric(RowWiseCompare$score_ref_PacBIO)

# Keep only high-confidence rows
score_Ref_cutoff <-
  (RowWiseCompare$CombiScore_Uniprot > scoreCutoff[1] |
   RowWiseCompare$Combiscore_ref      > scoreCutoff[1]) &
  (RowWiseCompare$CombiScore_Uniprot < scoreCutoff[2] &
   RowWiseCompare$CombiScore_Uniprot < scoreCutoff[2])

score_Ref_cutoff[is.na(score_Ref_cutoff)] <- FALSE

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Orthogonal distance regression between PB and UP delta masses
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
RowWiseCompare$Label <-
  paste(RowWiseCompare$hgnc_symbol,
        round(as.numeric(RowWiseCompare$IsoFrac_MW) / 1000),
        RowWiseCompare$Uniprot_Uniprot,
        RowWiseCompare$Uniprot,
        sep = "\n")

naorinf <- function(x) is.na(x) | is.infinite(x)

sel <- naorinf(RowWiseCompare$DM_PB_min) | naorinf(RowWiseCompare$DM_UP_min)
y   <- RowWiseCompare$DM_UP_min[!sel]
x   <- RowWiseCompare$DM_PB_min[!sel]

# Repeat points to stabilize the orthogonal regression fit
x <- c(x, y, y, y, y, y)
y <- c(y, y, y, y, y, y)

library(pracma)
odifun <- odregress(x = x, y = y)

RowWiseCompare$Residuals <- NA
RowWiseCompare$Residuals[!sel] <- odifun$resid[1:(length(x) / 6)]

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Define delta-mass categories
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
lmcheck <- function(x, y, n1, m1, n2, m2) {
  y1 <- m1 * x + n1
  y2 <- m2 * x + n2
  yall <<- sort(c(y1, y2))
  y > y1 & y < y2
}

a <- RowWiseCompare$DM_UP_min
b <- RowWiseCompare$DM_PB_min

windowSize <- dmDiff
fac <- 1.4

Dia      <- lmcheck(a, b, -windowSize * fac,  1, windowSize * fac,  1)
AntiDia  <- lmcheck(a, b, -windowSize * fac, -1, windowSize * fac, -1)
xequal   <- lmcheck(a, b, -windowSize, 0, windowSize, 0)
yequal   <- (a > -windowSize) & a < windowSize

DiffCategory <- paste(as.numeric(Dia),
                      as.numeric(AntiDia),
                      as.numeric(xequal),
                      as.numeric(yequal),
                      sep = "")

point_in_circle <- function(x, y, radius) {
  sqrt(x^2 + y^2) <= radius
}

DiffCategoryNew <- "other"
WithinCircle <- point_in_circle(a, b, windowSize * 1.5)

DiffCategoryNew[DiffCategory == "1000" & !WithinCircle & a > 0 & b > 0] <- "Equal MassShift+"
DiffCategoryNew[DiffCategory == "1000" & !WithinCircle & a < 0 & b < 0] <- "Equal MassShift-"

DiffCategoryNew[!WithinCircle & DiffCategory == "0010" & a > 0] <- "PACBIO correct+"
DiffCategoryNew[!WithinCircle & DiffCategory == "0001" & b > 0] <- "UniProt correct+"
DiffCategoryNew[!WithinCircle & DiffCategory == "0010" & a < 0] <- "PACBIO correct-"
DiffCategoryNew[!WithinCircle & DiffCategory == "0001" & b < 0] <- "UniProt correct-"

DiffCategoryNew[is.na(DiffCategoryNew)] <- "Other"
DiffCategoryNew[WithinCircle] <- "Correct Mass"

RowWiseCompare$Categories_Uniprot_Uniprot_fixed <- NULL
RowWiseCompare$DM_min_categories <- DiffCategoryNew

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Match each UniProt accession back to ProteinSequencesCategories
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
UPsplit <- strsplit(RowWiseCompare$Uniprot, ";")

if (!exists("UP_L_CombiScores") | 0) {
  load("ProteinSequencesCategories.rda")
  PSCnames <- names(ProteinSequencesCategories)

  # If needed, append PacBIO entries to the protein sequence table
  if (all(!grepl("ENSG", ProteinSequencesCategories$ProteinID))) {
    print("HU")
    ProteinSequencesCategories <- rbind(ProteinSequencesCategories, PacBIO, fill = TRUE)
  }

  ProteinSequencesCategories <- ProteinSequencesCategories[, .SD, .SDcols = PSCnames]

  UP_L_CombiScores <- lapply(UPsplit, function(x) {
    x <<- x
    x <- gsub(" # .*.", "", x)
    xtemp <- ProteinSequencesCategories[match(x, ProteinID)]

    if (dim(xtemp)[1] > 1) {
      xtemp <- apply(xtemp, 2, function(y) {
        y <- gsub("^ ", "", y)
        if (all(!is.na(as.logical(y)))) {
          any(as.logical(y))
        } else {
          paste(unique(y), collapse = ";")
        }
      })

      xtemp <- data.table(xtemp)
      xtemp <- t(xtemp)
      xtemp <- as.data.table(xtemp)
      colnames(xtemp) <- colnames(ProteinSequencesCategories)

      cleanedstring <- gsub("_.*.", "", lelu <- strsplit(xtemp$ID, ";")[[1]])
      cleanedstring <- gsub("-.*.", "", cleanedstring)

      if (length(unique(cleanedstring)) == 1) {
        xtemp$Multimapper <- FALSE
        xtemp$Variants <- length(cleanedstring)
      } else {
        xtemp$Multimapper <- TRUE
        xtemp$Variants <- length(lelu)
      }
    } else {
      xtemp$Multimapper <- FALSE
      xtemp$Variants <- 1
    }

    xtemp
  })

  UP_L_CombiScoresList <- UP_L_CombiScores
}

UP_L_CombiScores <- lapply(UP_L_CombiScoresList, function(x) {
  if (dim(x)[1] == 0) {
    x <<- x
    x <- rbind(x, "", fill = TRUE)
  }
  x
})

UP_Matched <- rbindlist(UP_L_CombiScores, fill = TRUE)

# Pull through UniProt-based isoform category annotations
RowWiseCompare$Uniprot_Isoform_Category <-
  Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered$Uniprot_Isoform_Category[
    match(RowWiseCompare$Uniprot, Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered$Uniprot)

# Refine annotations

RowWiseCompare$Categories_Uniprot_Uniprot_fixed[RowWiseCompare$Categories_Uniprot_Uniprot_fixed == "AS; AS"] <- "AS"

RowWiseCompare$Categories_Uniprot_Uniprot_fixed[RowWiseCompare$Categories_Uniprot_Uniprot_fixed == "Processing; AS"] <- "AS; Processing"

RowWiseCompare$UniprotIsoformType_Condensed <-
  convert_UniprotIsoformType(RowWiseCompare$UniprotIsoformType)

subset_table <- RowWiseCompare[(as.numeric(selectedScore_UP) > 0.8 | as.numeric(selectedScore_PB) > 0.8) & type == "fw"]
subset_table$UniprotIsoformType <- subset_table$UniprotIsoformType_Condensed
subset_table$UniprotIsoformType[is.na(subset_table$UniprotIsoformType)] <- "Diverse"

# Scatter of delta masses between PB and UP
gfu2 <-
  ggplot(subset_table,
         aes(DM_PB_min, DM_UP_min,
             color = DM_min_categories,
             label = paste(PACBIO_ACC, Uniprot))) +

  ylab("IsoFrac-UniProt MW [D]")

gfu2_Counts <-
  ggplot(subset_table, aes(DM_min_categories, fill = DM_min_categories)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "count")

Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$DM_plots <- list(DM = gfu2, counts = gfu2_Counts)

# Score ratio by delta-mass category
Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$Category_BP <-

Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$ProteinCategory_BP <-

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Summary counts for database / isoform type bins
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
DB_counts <- RowWiseCompare[(score_UP_gb_UP > 0.8 | score_UP_gb_PB > 0.8) & type == "fw", {
  ta <- table(UniprotIsoformType_Condensed)
  list(Isoform_Type = names(ta),
       count = as.vector(ta),
       count_rel = as.vector(ta) / sum(as.vector(ta)))
}, DataType]

DB_counts[, p := {
  temp <- .SD
  blackPicked <- sum(temp$count)
  AllCount <- sum(DB_counts$count)

  ps <<- temp[, {
    White    <- count
    Black    <- blackPicked - White
    AllWhite <- sum(DB_counts[DB_counts$Isoform_Type == .BY$Isoform_Type]$count)
    AllBlack <- AllCount - AllWhite
    hyper_equal_or_more(White, AllWhite, AllBlack, White + Black)
  }, Isoform_Type]

  ps$V1
}, .(DataType)]

DB_counts[, count_rel := count / sum(count), DataType]
DB_counts$p.adjust <- p.adjust(DB_counts$p, "BH")
DB_counts$p.adjust[DB_counts$p.adjust > 0.05] <- as.double(NA)

add_Label <- function(gg, hj = 0, vj = 1, angle = 0, repel = TRUE, setdirection = "both") {
  if (!repel) {
    gg +
      geom_label(aes(label = signif(p.adjust, 2)),
                 position = position_stack(vjust = vj),
                 hjust = hj, angle = angle, size = 2,
                 show.legend = FALSE) +
      guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(label = "", angle = angle)),
             lwd = guide_legend(override.aes = list(lwd = NA))) +
      theme(legend.title = element_blank())
  } else {
    gg +
      geom_label_repel(aes(label = signif(p.adjust, 2)),
                       position = position_stack(vjust = vj),
                       hjust = hj, angle = angle, size = 2,
                       direction = setdirection,
                       show.legend = FALSE) +
      guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(label = "", angle = angle))) +
      theme(legend.title = element_blank())
  }
}

if (class(DB_counts$DataType) != "factor") {

                               c("PB", "PB###UP", "UP"),

}

Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$FractionOfIdentifed <-

# Fractions by delta-mass category
subset_table_counts <- subset_table[score_UP_gb_PB != score_UP_gb_UP, {

}, DM_min_categories]

subset_table_countsAll <- subset_table[, {

}, ]

subset_table_countsAll$DM_min_categories <- "ALL"

subset_table_counts[, p := {

subset_table_counts$p.adjust <- p.adjust(subset_table_counts$p, "BH")
```

## Updating SQLITE Database
This section consolidates all IsoFrac analysis results into a structured SQLite database for downstream querying and visualization. It integrates PacBIO and UniProt assignments, per-gel clustering results, peak tables, and filtered isoform mappings into a unified schema. Additionally, a summarized isoform count table is generated to capture high-confidence isoform detections across experiments.

```{r}

## Updating SQLITE Database

IsofracCandidates <- list.files(pattern = "IsoFrac_\\d")
IsofracCandidates <- grep("7z$", IsofracCandidates, invert = TRUE, value = TRUE)

# Pick the newest IsoFrac output directory
pa <- sort(IsofracCandidates, decreasing = TRUE)[1]
setwd(pa)

library(RSQLite)

dbpath <- "./TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks.sqlite"

if (file.exists(dbpath)) {
  db <- dbConnect(SQLite(), dbpath)
  dbListTables(db)

  ## --------------------------------------------------
  ## 1) Write combined PacBIO / UniProt tables
  ## --------------------------------------------------
  Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$Pairs_Unfiltered$V1 <- NULL
  names(Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$Pairs_Unfiltered) <- make.unique(
    names(Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$Pairs_Unfiltered)
  )

  dbWriteTable(db, "CombiTable_PBUP", Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$Pairs_Unfiltered, overwrite = TRUE)
  dbWriteTable(db, "CombiTableFiltered_PBUP", Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$Pairs_Filtered, overwrite = TRUE)

  ## --------------------------------------------------
  ## 2) Prepare PacBIO unfiltered pairs
  ## --------------------------------------------------
  df <- Results_CombinedGels_PacBio$Pairs_Unfiltered_PacBio
  df$V1 <- NULL
  dful <- as.data.frame(apply(df, 2, unlist))
  colnames(dful) <- make.unique(colnames(dful))

  ## --------------------------------------------------
  ## 3) Prepare row-wise comparison tables for export
  ## --------------------------------------------------
  RowWiseCompare$PeakScore <- 100

  RowWiseCompare_PB <- RowWiseCompare[, .SD, .SDcols = c(
    "gel", "type", "ENSG", "IsoFrac", "dhyper_p",
    "Success_PB_Peptides", "All_Uniprot_Peptides", "Non_Uniprot_Peptides",
    "IsofracOverlap", "UniprotOverlap", "PACBIO_ACC", "PB_MW",
    "IsoFrac_MW", "Uniprot_MW", "DM_PB_min", "nClusters", "nGels",
    "heights", "Height", "Height_lm", "Fraction_sd_80", "gel_MainPeak",
    "score_ref_rf_PB"
  )]
  setnames(
    RowWiseCompare_PB,
    c("score_ref_rf_PB", "Success_PB_Peptides", "DM_PB_min", "PACBIO_ACC"),
    c("score_ref", "Success_Uniprot_Peptides", "DeltaMass", "Uniprot")
  )

  RowWiseCompare_UP <- RowWiseCompare[, .SD, .SDcols = c(
    "gel", "type", "ENSG", "IsoFrac", "dhyper_p",
    "Success_Uniprot_Peptides", "All_Uniprot_Peptides", "Non_Uniprot_Peptides",
    "IsofracOverlap", "UniprotOverlap", "Uniprot", "IsoFrac_MW",
    "DM_UP", "DM_UP_min", "DeltaMass", "nClusters", "nGels",
    "heights", "Height", "Height_lm", "Fraction_sd_80", "gel_MainPeak",
    "score_ref_rf_UP"
  )]
  setnames(
    RowWiseCompare_UP,
    c("score_ref_rf_UP", "DM_UP_min"),
    c("score_ref", "DeltaMass")
  )

  ## --------------------------------------------------
  ## 4) Export filtered best-match tables
  ## --------------------------------------------------
  PBfun <- as.data.frame(Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$BestMatch_PB)[
    , !duplicated(names(Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$BestMatch_PB))
  ]
  UPfun <- as.data.frame(Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$BestMatch_UP)[
    , !duplicated(names(Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$BestMatch_UP))
  ]

  PBfun$score_ref <- PBfun$score_UP_gb
  UPfun$score_ref <- UPfun$score_
  PBfun$score_ref_PacBIO <- PBfun$score_ref

  PBfun <- as.data.table(PBfun)
  UPfun <- as.data.table(UPfun)

  dbWriteTable(db, "CombinedGels_Pairs_Filtered_PACBIO", PBfun[PBfun$type == "fw"], overwrite = TRUE)
  dbWriteTable(db, "CombinedGels_Pairs_Filtered", UPfun[UPfun$type == "fw"], overwrite = TRUE)

  ## --------------------------------------------------
  ## 5) Write per-gel tables
  ## --------------------------------------------------
  GN <- lapply(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks, function(x) {
    gel <- x$xname
    dt_gn <- x$dt_gn
    dt_gn$gel <- gel
    dt_gn
  })
  GN <- rbindlist(GN)

  hdbscanTables <- lapply(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks, function(x) {
    xtemp <- x$hdbscanTables
    xtemp$Abu <- as.numeric(xtemp$Abu)
    xtemp$Gel <- x$xname
    xtemp
  })
  hdbscanTables <- rbindlist(hdbscanTables)

  TMTSubset_final_singlenorm_zscore <- lapply(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks, function(x) {
    x$TMTSubset_final_singlenorm_zscore
  })

  IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable <- lapply(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks, function(x) {
    xtemp <- x$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable
    xtemp$gel <- x$xname
    xtemp
  })
  IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable <- rbindlist(IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable)

  IdentifiedPeaks_Table <- lapply(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks, function(x) {
    xtemp <- x$IdentifiedPeaks_Table
    xtemp$gel <- x$xname
    xtemp
  })
  IdentifiedPeaks_Table <- rbindlist(IdentifiedPeaks_Table)

  IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable <- as.data.table(apply(IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable, 2, unlist), integer64 = "double")
  IdentifiedPeaks_Table <- as.data.table(apply(IdentifiedPeaks_Table, 2, unlist), integer64 = "double")

  gelnames <- sapply(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks, function(x) x$xname)

  dbWriteTable(db, "GN", GN, overwrite = TRUE)
  dbWriteTable(db, "Gels", data.frame(gels = gelnames), GN, overwrite = TRUE)

  dbWriteTable(db, "hdbscanTables", hdbscanTables, overwrite = TRUE)
  dbWriteTable(db, "IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable", IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable, overwrite = TRUE)
  dbWriteTable(db, "IdentifiedPeaks_Table", IdentifiedPeaks_Table, overwrite = TRUE)

  for (x in TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks) {
    dbWriteTable(db, paste("TMTSubset_final_singlenorm_zscore", x$xname, sep = "_#_"),
                 x$TMTSubset_final_singlenorm_zscore, overwrite = TRUE)
    dbWriteTable(db, paste("Protein_MW", x$xname, sep = "_#_"),
                 x$Protein_MW, overwrite = TRUE)
    dbWriteTable(db, paste("Fractions_MW", x$xname, sep = "_#_"),
                 data.frame(x$Fractions_predicted_MW), overwrite = TRUE)
    dbWriteTable(db, paste("hdbscanTables", x$xname, sep = "_#_"),
                 data.frame(x$hdbscanTables), overwrite = TRUE)
  }

  dbListTables(db)

  ## --------------------------------------------------
  ## 6) Write combined unfiltered / compressed / filtered tables
  ## --------------------------------------------------
  df <- Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Unfiltered
  dful <- as.data.frame(apply(df, 2, unlist))
  colnames(dful) <- make.unique(colnames(dful))

  Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$Pairs_Unfiltered$score_ref <- Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$Pairs_Unfiltered$score_ref_rf

  df <- Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$Pairs_Unfiltered
  names(df) <- make.unique(names(df))

  dbWriteTable(db, "CombinedGels_Pairs_Unfiltered", df, overwrite = TRUE)
  dbWriteTable(
    db,
    "CombinedGels_Compressed_Pairs",
    as.data.table(apply(Results_CombinedGels$Compressed_Pairs, 2, unlist), integer64 = "double"),
    overwrite = TRUE
  )

  colnames(Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered) <- make.unique(colnames(Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered))
  dbWriteTable(db, "CombinedGels_Pairs_Filtered", Results_CombinedGels$Pairs_Filtered, overwrite = TRUE)

  ## --------------------------------------------------
  ## 7) Build isoform count summary table
  ## --------------------------------------------------
  IsoformCount <- lapply(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks, function(x) {
    IP <- x$IdentifiedPeaks_Table
    IP$Height[lengths(IP$Height) == 0] <- 0

    IP <- IP[FDR_RF < 0.01, ]
    IP <- IP[unlist(Height) >= 0, ]
    IP <- IP[unlist(Fraction_width) < 2, ]

    IP <- IP[grep(";", ENS, invert = TRUE), {
      list(
        MWlog10 = unique(MW_lm_Compressed_),
        mpw = min(unlist(Height)),
        maxFracWidth = max(unlist(Fraction_width), na.rm = TRUE),
        MW_lm_lo = median(MW_lm_lo),
        MW_lm_hi = median(MW_lm_lo)
      )
    }, ENS]

    IP$Experiment <- x$xname
    IP
  })

  IsoformCountTable <- rbindlist(IsoformCount)
  table(IsoformCountTable$Experiment)

  IsoformCountTable$Experiment <- gsub("/peptides.txt", "", IsoformCountTable$Experiment)
  IsoformCountTable$Experiment <- gsub("/peptides_TryChymCOMBINED.txt", "_ChyTry", IsoformCountTable$Experiment)
  IsoformCountTable$Experiment <- gsub("2020_12_23_TMTpro_", "gel1_", IsoformCountTable$Experiment)
  IsoformCountTable$Experiment <- gsub("2021_10_09_TM.*.pro_", "gel2_", IsoformCountTable$Experiment)

  dbWriteTable(db, "IsoformCountTable", IsoformCountTable, overwrite = TRUE)

  ## --------------------------------------------------
  ## 8) Finalize
  ## --------------------------------------------------
  dbDisconnect(db)
  system("open ./")

  file.copy(
    "../Results_CombinedGels.rda",
    paste(dirname(dbpath), "Results_CombinedGels.rda", sep = "/"),
    overwrite = TRUE
  )
  setwd("../")
}

```


## Transcript and ORF Category Counts from PacBio and GENCODE

This section summarizes how many coding transcripts and ORFs fall into each combined category. It collapses overlapping labels into a few main groups, computes absolute and relative counts, and visualizes the distribution with pie and bar plots for the PacBio versus GENCODE comparison.


```{r}
library(data.table)
library(Peptides)

fa1 <- fread(
  "../../20220114_Isofrac_v2/IsoFrac_20230217_SimilaritiesTesting_4/Figure4_v2/Archive/protein_coding_transcript_info_uniq.txt",
  sep = "\t",
  header = FALSE
)
names(fa1) <- c("Category", "ENST", "ENSG", "Category2", "seq")

fa2 <- fread(
  "../../20220114_Isofrac_v2/IsoFrac_20230217_SimilaritiesTesting_4/Figure4_v2/Archive/protein_coding_transcript_ORFinfo_withAScategory.txt",
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE
)

## Basic size checks
fa1[, .(n_ENSG = length(unique(ENSG)), n_seq = length(unique(seq)))]
fa2[, .(n_ORF = length(unique(ORF_seq)))]

## Collapse transcript categories per sequence
fa1[, Category2_paste := paste(sort(unique(Category2)), collapse = ";"), by = seq]

Fun <- fa1[, .(
  Transcript = .N,
  ORF = length(unique(seq))
), by = Category2_paste]

Fun[, `:=`(
  V1_rel = Transcript / sum(Transcript),
  V2_rel = ORF / sum(ORF)
)]

## Simplify combined labels
for (i in rev(c("PB_&_GENCODE", "GENCODE_from_PBcorrected", "PB_only", "GENCODE_only"))) {
  Fun$Category2_paste[grep(i, Fun$Category2_paste)] <- i
  fa1$Category2_paste[grep(i, fa1$Category2_paste)] <- i
}

table(Fun$Category2_paste)

## Summarize by major group
FunFun <- Fun[, .(
  Transcript = sum(Transcript),
  ORF = sum(ORF)
), by = Category2_paste]

FunFunMelt <- melt(FunFun, id.vars = "Category2_paste")
FunFunMelt[, value_rel := value / sum(value), by = variable]
FunFunMelt[, TotalSum := sum(value), by = variable]
FunFunMelt[, GroupLabel := paste(variable, paste("(n=", TotalSum, ")", sep = ""))]

FunFunMelt$GroupLabel <- factor(
  FunFunMelt$GroupLabel,
  c(
    grep("ORF", unique(FunFunMelt$GroupLabel), value = TRUE, invert = TRUE),
    grep("ORF", unique(FunFunMelt$GroupLabel), value = TRUE)
  )
)
FunFunMelt$Category2_paste <- gsub("_", "\n", FunFunMelt$Category2_paste)

Results_CombinedGels_PacBio$BP_Counts <- ggplot(
  FunFunMelt,
  aes(
    Category2_paste,
    y = value,
    fill = Category2_paste,
    label = paste(round(value_rel * 100), "%")
  )
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap("GroupLabel", ncol = 1) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("Count") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2))
```

# Preparation Figure 4

### PacBio Isoform Selection and Evidence Filtering Across Expression and Size Constraints

This section prepares datasets for identifying PacBio-supported isoforms and evaluating their proteomic evidence. A custom selection procedure assigns each IsoFrac peak to the best matching database entry (based on scoring), while optionally enforcing unique sequence usage to avoid redundant assignments.

Multiple PacBio subsets are generated using different filtering strategies:
	•	All sequences
	•	Size-restricted sequences (merged isoforms)
	•	TPM-filtered subsets (expression thresholds)
	•	Combined size + TPM filters

These variations allow systematic comparison of how sequence redundancy and transcript abundance influence the number of confidently identified isoforms.


```{r}

# PACBIO exclusive peaks with only 1+ entries
message("PACBIO DB:")

scorediffs <- c(0.8, 0.5, -1, -1)

library(data.table)

# Assign each IsoFrac peak to the best matching database entry.
# Optionally remove already-used sequences while selecting the best hit per IsoFrac ID.
DB_IF_hits <- function(DB,
                       ALLPAIRS,
                       rdaname = "Pacbio_Identified.rda",
                       RemoveSequences = FALSE,
                       Rerun = FALSE) {
  if (!file.exists(rdaname) || Rerun) {
    PacBIOMatched <- DB[, {
      cat("\r", .GRP)

      temp <- .SD
      id_fun <- paste(temp$ProteinID, paste(temp$MW, "Da"), sep = " # ")

      funni <- ALLPAIRS[!is.na(match(Uniprot, id_fun)), ]
      if (nrow(funni) == 0) {
        funni <- ALLPAIRS[1, ]
      }

      funni$TPM <- sum(temp$Abundance_TPM)
      funni
    }, by = .(SEQUENCE)]

    # Sort by the best UniProt score first
    PacBIOMatched <- PacBIOMatched[order(score_UP_gb, decreasing = TRUE)]

    # Keep only the best entry per IsoFrac ID
    OutFun <- data.table()
    PacBIOMatched$IsoFracID <- paste(PacBIOMatched$ENSG, PacBIOMatched$IsoFrac_MW)

    IsoFracID <- unique(PacBIOMatched$IsoFracID)
    PacBIOMatchedTemp <- copy(PacBIOMatched)

    while (length(IsoFracID) > 0) {
      length_before <- length(IsoFracID)

      temp <- PacBIOMatchedTemp[1, ]
      PacBIOMatchedTemp <- PacBIOMatchedTemp[IsoFracID != temp$IsoFracID, ]

      if (RemoveSequences) {
        PacBIOMatchedTemp <- PacBIOMatchedTemp[SEQUENCE != temp$SEQUENCE, ]
      }

      IsoFracID <- IsoFracID[IsoFracID != temp$IsoFracID]
      IsoFracID <- IsoFracID[!is.na(IsoFracID)]

      OutFun <- rbind(OutFun, temp)

      cat("\r", paste("before", length_before, "after", length(IsoFracID)))
    }

    save(OutFun, RemoveSequences, PacBIOMatched, file = rdaname)
  }

  rdaname
}

# Build several PacBIO subsets to compare size and TPM restrictions
P1 <- PacBIO
DB_IF_hits(
  P1,
  Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$Pairs_Unfiltered[type == "fw"],
  rdaname = "Pacbio_Identified_ALL.rda",
  RemoveSequences = TRUE
)
load("Pacbio_Identified_ALL.rda")

P2 <- PacBIO[SEQUENCE == SequenceMerged]
DB_IF_hits(
  P2,
  Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$Pairs_Unfiltered[type == "fw"],
  rdaname = "Pacbio_Identified_SizeCondensed.rda",
  RemoveSequences = TRUE
)

P3 <- PacBIO[SEQUENCE == SequenceMerged & Abundance_TPM > 0]
DB_IF_hits(
  P3,
  Results_CombinedGels_PBUP$Pairs_Unfiltered[type == "fw"],
  rdaname = "Pacbio_Identified_SizeCondensed_TPM.rda",
```

### Plotting of evaluation of PacBio-Specific Isoform Evidence and Expression-Dependent Detection

This section visualizes the proteomic evidence for PacBio-specific isoforms across multiple filtering strategies. Isoforms are classified into evidence tiers (very good, good, low, or not detected) based on machine learning–derived scores, and compared across subsets defined by sequence redundancy and transcript abundance (TPM thresholds).

Barplots summarize the number of isoforms with varying levels of proteomic support under different conditions, while density and boxplots illustrate how expression (TPM) relates to identification confidence. Additional analyses quantify the fraction of isoforms supported by proteomics and assess how filtering strategies impact detection rates.

```{r}
# PACBIO exclusive peaks: evidence summary and plotting
# -----------------------------------------------------

scorediffs <- c(0.8, 0.5, -1, -1)

PB_IsoFrac_Evidences <- function(rdaname, SelectENSGs = NULL) {
  load(rdaname)

  if (length(SelectENSGs) > 0 && is.character(SelectENSGs)) {
    OutFun <- OutFun[!is.na(match(ENSG, SelectENSGs))]
    PacBIOMatched <- PacBIOMatched[!is.na(match(ENSG, SelectENSGs))]
  }

  MappedTable <- OutFun
  MappedTable$id <- seq_len(nrow(MappedTable))
  MappedTable$score_UP_gb[is.na(MappedTable$score_UP_gb)] <- -1
  MappedTable$score_UP_gb <- as.numeric(MappedTable$score_UP_gb)

  IDs <- list(
    High_Evidence = MappedTable[score_UP_gb > scorediffs[1]]$SEQUENCE,
    Good_Evidence = MappedTable[score_UP_gb <= scorediffs[1] & score_UP_gb > scorediffs[2]]$SEQUENCE,
    Low_Evidence  = MappedTable[score_UP_gb <= scorediffs[2] & score_UP_gb > scorediffs[3]]$SEQUENCE,
    No_Evidence   = setdiff(unique(PacBIOMatched$SEQUENCE), unique(MappedTable$SEQUENCE))
  )

  IDs <- lapply(IDs, unique)
  names(IDs) <- paste(
    names(IDs),
    c(
      paste(">", scorediffs[1], collapse = " "),
      paste(scorediffs[c(1, 2)], collapse = " to "),
      paste(scorediffs[c(2, 3)], collapse = " to "),
      ""
    )
  )

  PB_identified <- data.table(
    V1 = lengths(IDs),
    V2 = names(lengths(IDs))
  )
  PB_identified$V2 <- factor(PB_identified$V2, levels = names(IDs))

  gg <- ggplot(PB_identified, aes(V2, V1, fill = V2, label = V1)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
    geom_text(vjust = -1) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) +
    ylab("PACBIO IsoForm proteomic Evidences")

  list(gg = gg, table = PB_identified)
}
```

```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper: remove selected layers from an existing ggplot object
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
gg_layerremove <- function(gg, removeTag = "PeakPosition|alpha") {
  gg$layers <- lapply(gg$layers, function(x) {
    if (any(grepl(removeTag, names(x$data)))) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    x
  })
  gg$layers <- gg$layers[lengths(gg$layers) > 0]
  gg
}
```
